# Quarterly Roadmap Planning — Northwind Fabricators

Notes taken by the attendee. Not a verbatim record.

## Attendees

Dana Ortiz (Operations), Priya Chandrasekaran (Engineering), Marcus Webb (Finance), and Elena
Vogt (Product) joined the planning session on 3 September.

## Topics discussed

Dana opened with an update on the warehouse relocation. She said the new site in Leeds would be
ready for stock transfer by 12 October, and that the lease on the current site runs out on
30 November.

Priya raised the backlog on the conveyor firmware update. She said two of the four planned
sensors had failed calibration testing, and that a replacement batch had been ordered from the
supplier.

Marcus presented the Q3 numbers. He said revenue came in at 4.2 million euros against a forecast
of 4.5 million, and attributed the shortfall to the Leeds delay. He said the Q4 forecast stands
at 5.1 million euros.

Elena described the packaging redesign. She said customer feedback on the prototype had been
positive at eight of ten trial sites, and that the remaining two sites had not yet responded.

## Decisions

Dana said the team would proceed with the Leeds move on the current timeline.

Marcus said the finance team would revise the Q4 forecast once the Leeds site is operational.

Priya said she would follow up with the sensor supplier directly, since she raised it on the
call.

## Figures mentioned

- Leeds site ready: 12 October
- Current lease ends: 30 November
- Q3 revenue: 4.2 million euros (forecast 4.5 million)
- Q4 forecast: 5.1 million euros
- Prototype approval: eight of ten trial sites
